general.notes: BiDi pair: SO-SFP-MR25-BX40D-35 (Tx/Rx 1310/1550 nm) and SO-SFP-MR25-BX40D-53 (Tx/Rx 1550/1310 nm) on single fiber. Overview states bridgeable distance up to 10 km; TECHNICAL DATA and ordering state typical reach 40 km. Power budget 8–19 dB (1310 nm direction) and 3–13 dB (1550 nm direction); ordering lists 19 dB/13 dB and 13 dB/19 dB per variant. Operating temperature also -40°C to +85°C for -BxxI- (Industrial) variants. Storage -40°C to +85°C. Tx/Rx wavelength ranges footnoted per -35 vs -53. Minimum input power and overload at BER ≤ 1×10⁻¹², back-to-back (footnote 4). Transmitter output power is average power (footnote 3). Dispersion penalty max 1 dB stated without paired tolerance in ps/nm. DDM per SFF-8472. Protocols cited: FE, GbE, STM1/OC3, STM4/OC12, STM16/OC48, OTU1, 1G FC, 2G FC, CPRI Opt 1/2/3, OBSAI 1x/2x.
general.suggestions: Schema temp_min_c/temp_max_c are scalars; this family has C-temp (0 to +70°C) and I-temp (-40 to +85°C) variants—consider list fields or variant-specific records. Power budget (dB) and dispersion penalty (max 1 dB) have no dedicated fields. Reach 10 km vs 40 km conflict may need vendor clarification.
